item.title: @troyesivan's advice? Go make music in your bedroom 🎶
item.description:
@troyesivan's advice? Go make music in your bedroom 🎶

“Making music at home is like the biggest hack of all time. Even if you're not a musician, I think you are. You just don't know it.”

The singer shares how he made his new album “She’s the Best” in a new creative process. Watch the full video now on Instagram.
item.dc:creator: instagram

item.title: @troyesivan takes us behind the scenes at Irving Plaza in New York City. The singer breaks down the making of his new album “She’s the Best” — fro...
item.description:
@troyesivan takes us behind the scenes at Irving Plaza in New York City. The singer breaks down the making of his new album “She’s the Best” — from writing “really honestly, maybe too honestly” to producing and recording his own vocals at home for the first time.

“I think the reason why I make music is to feel understood. I try and write about stuff that sometimes is a little bit uncomfortable to think about or to sit in.”

item.title: For designer @____t_a_t_a___, nature is the ultimate muse — unpredictable, strange, textured, and “beautiful and unsettling at the same time.”⁣
item.description:
For designer @____t_a_t_a___, nature is the ultimate muse — unpredictable, strange, textured, and “beautiful and unsettling at the same time.”⁣
⁣
Her process mirrors nature. Every piece is made freehand, through improvisation and instinct, allowing “the process to unfold naturally rather than deciding what the final result should look like.”⁣
⁣
Video by @____t_a_t_a___

item.title: “Wouldn’t it be fun to have something like this in a room?”⁣
item.description:
“Wouldn’t it be fun to have something like this in a room?”⁣
⁣
That’s what painter @hichiyan686 asks herself before creating three-dimensional works like this vintage wall phone.⁣
⁣
Her creative process? “I close my eyes and imagine myself floating beneath the sea. In that imaginary underwater world, I turn the words, images and sensations I encounter into paintings.”⁣
⁣
Video by @hichiyan686
